title: UK software firm Pinewood's stock fell ~31% on Feb. 16 after Apax Partners withdrew its £575M takeover offer, citing "prevailing challenging market conditions" (Alexandra Heal/Financial Times)
summary: Alexandra Heal / Financial Times: UK software firm Pinewood's stock fell ~31% on Feb. 16 after Apax Partners withdrew its £575M takeover offer, citing “prevailing challenging market conditions” — Apax Partners abandons offer for FTSE 250 company over ‘challenging market conditions’
contentText:
Alexandra Heal / Financial Times :

UK software firm Pinewood's stock fell ~31% on Feb. 16 after Apax Partners withdrew its £575M takeover offer, citing “prevailing challenging market conditions”   —  Apax Partners abandons offer for FTSE 250 company over ‘challenging market conditions’
